skill.wukong.ju_xing_san_qi.tooltip:
The Destined One harnessed the wicked essence of an adversary to attain this Enhancement to nimble movement.

With an incantation, a phantom form remains behind, while your true self dissipates, nimble and elusive like wisps of smoke.

Evading the enemy's sharp blade, you can lure foes closer and engage them strategically.

Upon returning to your form, a swift kick or an Unveiling Strike may be unleashed, catching your foe off balance.
